one_liner: Asana is a cloud-based project and work management platform for team collaboration.

auth.notes: Personal Access Token (PAT) and OAuth 2.0 (authorization code grant) are primary methods; Service Accounts (Enterprise tier) also use Bearer tokens; OpenID Connect available.

evidence.snippet: A personal access token (PAT) is the quickest and simplest way to authenticate in the API.
Asana supports the authorization code grant flow

access.notes: Free Asana account enables PAT generation and API testing; OAuth apps default to private; developer sandbox available on request for premium features.

evidence.snippet: You can test in any of your existing workspaces, create a free account, or request a developer sandbox
You can generate a personal access token from the Asana developer console
By default, all apps start out private to the developer.

api_surface.rate_limit_note: Free tier: 150 req/min, Paid tier: 1,500 req/min; per-token limits; standard, volume, and job concurrency rate limiters

Limits are based on minute-long windows and differ depending on whether the domain is free or paid
